description: This file defines a React functional component 'VectorStoreTester' that provides a UI for testing vector store search functionality. It includes state management for search queries, loading status, search history, and result expansion. The component interacts with an external search API, displays search results with expandable details, and manages user interactions such as initiating searches and clearing history.

methods.name: handleSearch
methods.description: Performs a vector store search using the given query, updates the search history, and handles loading state and errors.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keydown events in the textarea, triggers search on Enter key press unless Shift is held.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a human-readable string.

methods.name: clearHistory
methods.description: Clears the search history and expanded results, and displays a success notification.

methods.name: toggleResultExpansion
methods.description: Toggles the expansion state of a specific search result.
